editor_note: Entry 10 is faithful: the little-endian Qiskit default, the `big` BitArray default and the contrast that the Sampler/Estimator primitives return Big-Endian-Ergebnisse while Executor returns Little-Endian-Ergebnisse all come through correctly, with Primitives kept in English as elsewhere on the page.

The seven rewritten headings are faithful, idiomatic German infinitive headings ("Überwachen, kalibrieren und benchmarken", "Parameter überwachen", "Ganzheitlich überwachen", "Kalibrieren", "Benchmarken") and keep every anchor intact.

The meaning of all five rewritten entries matches the English, and none of them would mislead a learner. Entry 11 ends with "kommst du am besten los", which is not idiomatic German: "loskommen" means "to break free", not "to get started". It should read "legst du am besten los". Entries 10 and 11 also call circuits "Circuits", while the rest of the page uses "Quantenschaltkreise" and "Schaltkreis" (entries 13 and 17), so the same term appears in two forms in one file.

Entry 5 is faithful and natural German, keeps the informal du ("kann dir die Aufgabe erleichtern"), and renders every clause, including "clientseitigen Sampler und Estimator", "V1-Primitives", "von IBM verifizierte Agent-Skills" and the future-skills promise, without drift.

editor_note: Entry 42 is faithful and reads naturally. It keeps "(ununterscheidbarer) Fermionen", "Antisymmetrie unter Austausch", the bosonic-operator requirement and "hermitesch als auch unitär". It also uses "Mapping"/"Jordan-Wigner-Transformation" the same way as the rest of the file.

The meaning holds throughout. Conditions, quantities and caveats match the English, including the bias caveat and the gamma convention, so nothing here would mislead a learner. Core terms drift between several forms within the file. Post-selection appears as "Postselektion", "Post-Selection" and "Post-Selektion". Stabilizer appears as "Stabilizer" and "Stabilisator", and detection as "Erkennung" and "Detektion". Detection region appears as "Erkennungsbereich", "Detektionsbereich" and "Detektionsregion", code distance as "Code-Distanz" and "Code-Abstand", wire as "Wire" and "Leitung", and spacetime as "Spacetime" and "Raumzeit". "Circuit" is used both as der and das, for example "die ursprüngliche Circuit" and "das Circuit". There are also a typo ("Ausleesefehler") and a few stiff calques ("Polarstern", "ohne zu laufen", "Wenn das Ziel viele Samples schnell sind").

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through, including the TREX worked table, the ZNE caveats and the PEC by-hand derivation. I found no drift that would mislead a learner. The problems are terminology consistency. "Error mitigation" is "Fehlermitigation" up to about [117] and then switches to "Fehlerminderung" / "Auslesefehler-Minderung" from [118] on. PEC appears as the English "Probabilistic Error Cancellation" in [11]/[12] and then as "probabilistische Fehlerauslöschung" from [203] on. "Unbiased" is "erwartungstreu" in [12]/[65]/[83] but "unverzerrt" in [208]/[227]/[447]. There are also some small slips: the typo "lineärer" in [217], ordinals doubled as "$i^\text{th}$-te" in [136], decimal points (86.4 %, 0.2 %) mixed with commas (54,5 %), and "Noise cancellation" in [254] rendered as "Rauschunterdrückung durch Invertierung", which blurs it with suppression.

editor_note: Both rewritten entries are faithful. In [6], "Überblick über Fehlerunterdrückung ... wie sie funktioniert" agrees with the singular noun. The four rewritten course and module titles ("Quantenchemie mit VQE", "Einen Quantencomputer heute nutzen", "Qiskit im Unterricht – Informatik/Quantenmechanik") keep the English meaning and read naturally in German, with the en dash used correctly.

Both rewritten link titles are faithful and idiomatic: "Qiskit im Unterricht – Informatik" and "Qiskit im Unterricht – Quantenmechanik". They use proper German en-dash spacing, and the link targets are unchanged.

The meaning holds throughout. Variational-bound claims, the M_J/product-stage argument, the angle comparison in the appendix and the noise caveats all match the English. The terminology changes partway through the page: "Hamiltonian" becomes "Hamiltonoperator" from [131] on, "Löser" becomes "Solver", "Teilchenart" becomes "Sorte", and "Sample-basierte" becomes "Probenbasierte" in [149]. "Ansatz" appears with the wrong gender ("ein festes ... Anregungs-Ansatz" [8], "das Ansatz" [145]), and so does "Circuit" ("Das jeweils leerste Circuit" [76]). examples.suggested: Auf das Beschneiden zu verzichten ist bei Hardwareläufen im Allgemeinen vorzuziehen
examples.why: Misspelled plural: the dative plural of "Lauf" is "Läufen".

examples.source: at an interatomic separation of 1.09 $\AA$
examples.translation: bei einem interatomaren Abstand von 1.09 $\AA$
examples.suggested: bei einem interatomaren Abstand von 1,09 $\AA$
examples.why: German prose writes the decimal separator as a comma.

editor_note: Entry 18 keeps the English meaning, including the safety caveat: "Solange du das nicht getan hast, speichert die Zelle nichts, sodass das Ausführen aller Zellen nie ein zuvor gespeichertes Konto überschreiben kann". The step references (Schritt 4 and 5) are correct and it stays in the informal "du" register.

Both rewritten titles are faithful and idiomatic: [37] "Shadow-Tomographie des Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger-Zustands" and [38] "Simulation der Zeitentwicklung des Ising-Modells im transversalen Feld" are accurate, and the nominal style of [38] matches sibling titles [61] and [62].

None of the 60 rewritten entries changes the meaning: the bound statements (nothing below −40.472331 MeV), the "discard vs repair" contrast, per-step vs pooled reprocessing and the hardware caveats all match the English. Entry 226 has broken German syntax: after "Beachte, dass …" it continues with main-clause word order ("stehen diese beiden Zahlen dort"). Several terms are rendered more than one way in the file: span is "Spann" (181) and "Aufspann" (193), rank is "gerankt" (172), "ordne" (189) and "ranken" (195), species is "Teilchenart" (183/188) and "Teilchensorte" (220), and the title uses "Sample-basierte … nuklearen Hamiltonians" (5) next to "sample-basierte … Kern-Hamiltonians" (1). Smaller slips: "Gerätrauschen" should be "Geräterauschen" (213), "per step" is rendered "schrittweise", which reads as "gradually" (209/213), and "pinned client" is rendered "fest eingebundene" (211).

examples.source: Note that on the two-body header line of a `.snt` file, those two numbers sit where an oscillator frequency and a core energy would plausibly go
examples.translation: Beachte, dass in der Zweikörper-Kopfzeile einer `.snt`-Datei stehen diese beiden Zahlen dort, wo plausibel eine Oszillatorfrequenz und eine Kernrumpfenergie stehen würden
examples.suggested: Beachte, dass diese beiden Zahlen in der Zweikörper-Kopfzeile einer `.snt`-Datei genau dort stehen, wo man eine Oszillatorfrequenz und eine Kernrumpfenergie erwarten würde
examples.why: Ungrammatical: a dass-clause needs verb-final word order. The sentence reads like an unedited splice.

examples.source: Build the Hamiltonian in the span of the unique kept determinants
examples.translation: Baue den Hamiltonian im Aufspann der eindeutigen beibehaltenen Determinanten auf
examples.suggested: Baue den Hamiltonian im Aufspann (in der linearen Hülle) der eindeutigen beibehaltenen Determinanten auf; entry 181 entsprechend 'im Aufspann' statt 'im Spann'
examples.why: 'span' is 'Spann' in 181 and 'Aufspann' here. 'Spann' is not the usual German term.

examples.source: whose excitations are ranked by second-order perturbation theory
examples.translation: dessen Anregungen nach Störungstheorie zweiter Ordnung gerankt werden
examples.suggested: dessen Anregungen nach Störungstheorie zweiter Ordnung geordnet werden
examples.why: 'gerankt' is an anglicism, and the file also uses 'ordne' (189) and 'ranken' (195) for the same operation.

examples.source: Saved samples, including those from a hardware run, can therefore only be reprocessed per step.
examples.translation: Gespeicherte Samples, auch solche aus einem Hardware-Lauf, können daher nur schrittweise neu verarbeitet werden.
examples.suggested: … können daher nur pro Schritt (einzeln) neu verarbeitet werden.
examples.why: 'schrittweise' usually means 'gradually'. It hides the point that the files are processed one at a time and never pooled.

examples.source: Counts and energies depend on the samples and device noise.
examples.translation: Counts und Energien hängen von den Samples und vom Gerätrauschen ab.
examples.suggested: … und vom Geräterauschen ab.
examples.why: The correct compound form is 'Geräterauschen'.

editor_note: All three rewritten entries say what the English says. Entry 18 keeps Qiskit Runtime in English and renders "error suppression and mitigation" as "Fehlerunterdrückung und -minderung". Entry 65's "in annotierte Boxen einteilt" and entry 71's reordered causal clause ("Da beim Boxen von Circuits … erfasst wird, führen wir … `canonical_qubits` ein") read naturally and match the page's terms (Circuit-Instruktionen, Qubit-Reihenfolge).

Entry 126 is faithful and reads naturally: 'map these Pauli terms to the canonical form expected by the Executor' becomes 'diese Pauli-Terme in die kanonische Form abbilden, die vom `Executor` erwartet wird', and the docs pointer uses informal 'findest du in der Samplomatic-Dokumentation'.

The meaning is faithful throughout, so nothing here would mislead a learner. That includes the caveats that QAOA does no better than uniform random sampling at 40 assets ([21], [55]) and that the 8-asset run is effectively a brute-force check ([43]). The remaining issues are calques and stiff phrasing. Weight sweeping is rendered with the awkward verb "durchfahren" ([9], [19], [40]). Other calques are "Risiko gegenüber Rendite gegenüber Diversifikation" ([19]), "immer noch wenige genug" and the elliptical "und nichts anderes an der Methode" ([46]), "eine sanfte Verzerrung" for "gentle bias" ([53]), and "wirst du voraussichtlich Folgendes verstehen" ([7]).

examples.source: Sweeping the weights sweeps the relative importance of risk versus return versus diversification
examples.translation: Das Durchfahren der Gewichte variiert die relative Bedeutung von Risiko gegenüber Rendite gegenüber Diversifikation
examples.suggested: Variiert man die Gewichte, verschiebt sich die relative Bedeutung von Risiko, Rendite und Diversifikation
examples.why: 'Durchfahren' and the doubled 'gegenüber' are calques of the English. The same verb comes back in [9] and [40].

examples.source: are still few enough to enumerate classically ... Several things change, and nothing else about the method does
examples.translation: sind immer noch wenige genug, um sie klassisch aufzuzählen ... Mehrere Dinge ändern sich, und nichts anderes an der Methode
examples.suggested: sind noch überschaubar genug, um sie klassisch aufzuzählen ... Einige Dinge ändern sich; ansonsten bleibt die Methode unverändert
examples.why: 'wenige genug' is a calque. The elliptical last clause leaves out its verb and reads unclearly in German.

examples.source: so the circuit applies a gentle bias rather than a sharp projection
examples.translation: sodass der Circuit eher eine sanfte Verzerrung als eine scharfe Projektion anwendet
examples.suggested: sodass der Circuit die Verteilung nur leicht gewichtet, statt scharf zu projizieren
examples.why: 'Verzerrung' suggests distortion, but the English means a gentle tilt of the probabilities. This weakens the intuition slightly.

examples.source: After completing this tutorial, you can expect to understand:
examples.translation: Nach Abschluss dieses Tutorials wirst du voraussichtlich Folgendes verstehen:
examples.suggested: Nach diesem Tutorial verstehst du:
examples.why: 'voraussichtlich' is a stiff literal rendering of 'you can expect to'.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The sample-complexity claims ($3^k$ vs $4^k$), the median-of-means steps, the postselection logic and the hardware interpretation all match the source, and nothing would mislead a learner. The remaining problems are consistency slips. The spelling switches from "Shadow-Tomographie" ([0]–[34]) to "Shadow-Tomografie" ([72] onward). "Circuit" changes gender: it is masculine in "einen GHZ-Circuit" ([52], [55]) but feminine in "die tiefe GHZ-Circuit" ([75]) and "jede Circuit" ([82]). "Sampler-Primitive" is feminine in [63] and neuter in [82]. The heading "Beispiel für Hardware im großen Maßstab" ([74]) is clunky and misplaces what is large-scale, and the rest of the file already uses "großskaliges Hardware-Beispiel".

examples.source: The shot scaling of shadow tomography is assessed...
examples.translation: Die Shot-Skalierung der Shadow-Tomografie wird bewertet...
examples.suggested: Die Shot-Skalierung der Shadow-Tomographie wird bewertet...
examples.why: Entries [0]–[34] spell it 'Tomographie' and [72]/[75]/[86] switch to 'Tomografie'. Pick one spelling for the whole file.

examples.source: gate and readout errors accumulate across the deep GHZ circuit
examples.translation: Gate- und Auslesefehler summieren sich über die tiefe GHZ-Circuit auf
examples.suggested: Gate- und Auslesefehler summieren sich über den tiefen GHZ-Circuit auf
examples.why: 'Circuit' is masculine in [52] and [55] ('einen GHZ-Circuit') but feminine here and in [82] ('jede Circuit'). Use one gender throughout.

examples.source: submits them to the Sampler primitive with `shots=8` (each circuit produces eight independent bitstrings)
examples.translation: übergibt sie mit `shots=8` an das Sampler-Primitive (jede Circuit erzeugt acht unabhängige Bitstrings)
examples.suggested: übergibt sie mit `shots=8` an das Sampler-Primitive (jeder Circuit erzeugt acht unabhängige Bitstrings)
examples.why: This mixes genders. 'Sampler-Primitive' is feminine in [63] ('die Sampler-Primitive') but neuter here, and 'Circuit' is feminine here but masculine elsewhere in the file.

examples.source: Large-scale hardware example
examples.translation: Beispiel für Hardware im großen Maßstab
examples.suggested: Großskaliges Hardware-Beispiel
examples.why: This reads as 'an example of large-scale hardware', so 'large-scale' attaches to the hardware instead of the experiment. It also breaks with [50] ('großskaligen Hardware-Beispiel') and [58] ('Kleinskaliges Simulator-Beispiel').

editor_note: Nothing in the 86 rewritten entries would mislead a learner. The numbers, conditions and caveats all match the English: the 1137 of 10000 shots, 49 of 120 determinants, the 0.1373 Ha gap, the order-of-normalization warning and the "not verified on Linux" note. The problems are consistency. The rewritten entries use "Hamiltonian" (20, 120, 122, 126, 146, 165), but the untouched rest of the page uses "Hamiltonoperator". Configuration recovery is "Konfigurations-Recovery" in 99 but "Konfigurationswiederherstellung" in 164, 167 and 170. There are also a few small slips. In entry 168, "obwohl" turns the English "while" into a concession, when the 49/120 coverage is really the reason for the gap. Entry 46 uses "sie" to refer back to neuter "das FCIDump", and entry 129 has a mixed subjunctive.

examples.source: Load the molecular Hamiltonian
examples.translation: Den molekularen Hamiltonian laden
examples.suggested: Den molekularen Hamiltonoperator laden
examples.why: The rewritten C++ entries (also 20, 122, 123, 126, 146, 165) use 'Hamiltonian', but the rest of the page uses 'Hamiltonoperator' throughout. The term is inconsistent within the file.

examples.source: The run therefore sits about `0.1373` Ha above exact while spanning 49 of the 120 $\alpha$-determinants.
examples.translation: Der Lauf liegt somit etwa `0.1373` Ha über dem exakten Wert, obwohl er 49 der 120 $\alpha$-Determinanten abdeckt.
examples.suggested: Der Lauf liegt somit etwa `0.1373` Ha über dem exakten Wert und deckt dabei nur 49 der 120 $\alpha$-Determinanten ab.
examples.why: 'obwohl' makes this a concession. The next sentence says the incomplete subspace is the cause of the gap, so the 49/120 coverage is the reason, not a contrast.

examples.source: since it postselects rather than recovers
examples.translation: da er Postselektion statt Konfigurations-Recovery verwendet
examples.suggested: da er Postselektion statt Konfigurationswiederherstellung verwendet
examples.why: Configuration recovery is 'Konfigurations-Recovery' here but 'Konfigurationswiederherstellung' in entries 164, 167 and 170.

examples.source: You can run the code below to fetch it into the location the rest of the tutorial expects.
examples.translation: Du kannst den untenstehenden Code ausführen, um sie an den Ort zu holen, den der Rest des Tutorials erwartet.
examples.suggested: Mit dem folgenden Code kannst du es an den Ort holen, an dem der Rest des Tutorials es erwartet.
examples.why: The pronoun 'sie' does not agree with the antecedent 'das FCIDump' in the same paragraph. 'den ... erwartet' is also a stiff calque.

examples.source: Using the sum instead would make $\lambda$ scale with group size
examples.translation: Würde man stattdessen die Summe verwenden, skaliert $\lambda$ mit der Gruppengröße
examples.suggested: Würde man stattdessen die Summe verwenden, skalierte $\lambda$ mit der Gruppengröße
examples.why: The conditional clause is subjunctive but the main clause is indicative. A German editor would make them consistent.

editor_note: I found no meaning errors. The Trotter step-size trade-off in [63] and [67], the staggered-magnetization argument in [62] and the bit-ordering example in [33] and [34] all match the English. The issues are small polish points. The model name appears in two forms: "Ising-Modell im transversalen Feld" ([0], [1], [10], [15]) and "Ising-Modell mit transversalem Feld" ([36]). [36] also says "beschrieben" twice in one clause. "fractional R_ZZ gate" is rendered as "gebrochene", which reads oddly; "fraktionale" is more usual. "truncation fidelity" is rendered as the hybrid "Abschneidungs-Fidelity", and in [38] the pronoun "er" now points to the Hilbert-Raum instead of the approach.

examples.source: described by the transverse-field Ising model above
examples.translation: die durch das oben beschriebene Ising-Modell mit transversalem Feld beschrieben wird
examples.suggested: die durch das oben eingeführte Ising-Modell im transversalen Feld beschrieben wird
examples.why: 'beschrieben' appears twice in one clause. The model name also differs from the 'im transversalen Feld' used everywhere else.

examples.source: the fractional $R_\mathrm{ZZ}$ gate is not yet available
examples.translation: das gebrochene $R_\mathrm{ZZ}$-Gate
examples.suggested: das fraktionale $R_\mathrm{ZZ}$-Gate
examples.why: In German, IBM's 'fractional gates' are usually called 'fraktionale Gates'. 'gebrochen' can also mean 'broken'.

examples.source: reported as a truncation fidelity for each run
examples.translation: als Abschneidungs-Fidelity angegeben
examples.suggested: als Trunkierungs-Fidelity angegeben
examples.why: 'Abschneidungs-Fidelity' is an awkward hybrid of German and English. The usual term is 'Trunkierung'/'Truncation-Fidelity'.

examples.source: making it impractical for larger systems
examples.translation: sodass er für größere Systeme unpraktikabel ist
examples.suggested: was diesen Ansatz für größere Systeme unpraktikabel macht
examples.why: 'er' grammatically refers to the Hilbert-Raum, but in the English 'it' is the simulation approach. Small change of referent.
